pages.title: Private Online File Viewer – Open 140+ Formats Locally
pages.description: Open, inspect, compare, and edit 140+ file formats locally in your browser. Private by default, with no signup, analytics, or tracking.

schema.name: File Viewer

pages.title: Supported File Formats | Private Browser File Viewer
pages.description: Browse guides to common formats supported by File Viewer, including PDF, CSV, JSON, Office documents, ebooks, databases, and archives.

pages.title: Private PDF Viewer – Open PDFs Locally in Your Browser
pages.description: Preview PDF pages and inspect document metadata locally in your browser, with text and page-image export options and no routine file upload.

pages.title: Private CSV Viewer and Editor – View Tables Locally
pages.description: View and edit CSV or TSV files as tables, compare changes, choose delimiters, and export JSON or XLSX locally in your browser.

pages.title: Private JSON Viewer, Formatter, Editor, and Diff Tool
pages.description: Open, format, edit, preview, and compare JSON locally in your browser with structured views and format-conversion tools.

pages.title: Private YAML Viewer and Editor – Inspect YAML Locally
pages.description: View, edit, format, and compare YAML locally with a structured preview and browser-based table and form tools.

pages.title: Private XML Viewer, Editor, and Structural Diff Tool
pages.description: View, edit, format, and compare XML locally with a structured document preview and DOM-aware diff in your browser.

pages.title: Private Markdown Viewer and Editor with Live Preview
pages.description: Read, edit, preview, and compare Markdown locally with source and visual editing modes in one private browser workspace.

pages.title: Private DOCX Viewer – Open Word Documents Locally
pages.description: Open and review Microsoft Word DOCX document content locally in your browser without first uploading it to a conversion website.

pages.title: Private XLSX Viewer – Open Excel Workbooks Locally
pages.description: Browse Microsoft Excel XLSX sheets in an interactive grid and export table data as CSV or JSON locally in your browser.

pages.title: Private PPTX Viewer – Preview PowerPoint Slides Locally
pages.description: Preview Microsoft PowerPoint PPTX presentations as navigable slides locally in your browser without a routine file upload.

pages.title: Private EPUB Reader – Open Ebooks Locally in Your Browser
pages.description: Read EPUB ebooks locally with chapter navigation, book metadata, embedded images, and a focused browser-based reading view.

pages.title: Private SQLite Viewer – Browse Database Tables Locally
pages.description: Inspect SQLite schemas, tables, columns, and rows locally in your browser without uploading the database to a remote query service.

pages.title: Private ZIP Viewer – Inspect Archive Contents Locally
pages.description: Browse files and folders inside ZIP archives, inspect entry metadata, and open supported contents locally in your browser.

pages.title: ASCII Art Generator – Image and Webcam ASCII Studio
pages.description: Convert an image or live webcam view into configurable ASCII art locally in your browser with text and image export tools.
